name: Armin Briegel
bio: Armin Briegel has been managing Macs and their users since the time when Apple was beleaguered. He has had a vast collection of technical job titles. He worked for at Apple in Germany and the US as a WebObjects and Server Consulting Engineer. Then, he put theory into practice as a System Administrator at University of Southern California. He currently works for Jamf in Europe. He also writes on his weblog, scriptingosx.com and has published books for Apple Administrators.
